acquisition method: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed in a data-dependent mode
collision energy: HCD-MS/MS (resolution of 15,000) of the most intense ions in 3 s was used to fragment multiply charged ions within a 1.4 Da isolation window at a normalized collision energy of 32%
enrichment method: used ConA-agarose beads to pull down the PNGase F-treated proteins
fragmentation method: LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted
instrument: LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: The results uncovered 17 proteins in the secretory pathway with decreased ConA binding (>2-fold change) in TMTC1 knockdown cells
mass analyzer: LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
